subject: set_theme(theme_bw()) doesn't seem to work when invoking print(gg)

messages.author: 467324c7303934a0
messages.subject: set_theme(theme_bw()) doesn't seem to work when invoking print(gg)
parts:
In a book being produced with knitr from .Rnw files, I want to use `theme_bw()` by default for all ggplot2 graphs.  So in the head chunk I have

<<echo=FALSE>>=
# source("Rprofile.R")
# knitrSet("ch07")
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())  # set default ggplot theme
@

This works when I call ggplot() directly, but the theme_set() seems to be ignored if I use the following form:

<<arth-cond1, h=4, w=6, out.width='.6\\textwidth', cap='Conditional plot of Arthritis data showing separate points and fitted curves stratified by Treatment.'>>=
library(ggplot2)
gg <- ggplot(Arthritis, aes(Age, Better, color = Treatment)) +
  xlim(5, 95) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.02, width = 0)) +
  stat_smooth(method = "glm", family = binomial, alpha = 0.2,
              aes(fill = Treatment), size = 2.5, fullrange = TRUE)
gg   # show the plot
@



Or this:

<<arth-cond2, h=4, w=8, out.width='.8\\textwidth', cap='Conditional plot of Arthritis data, stratified by Treatment and Sex.'>>=
gg + facet_wrap(~ Sex)
@

These give the following plots, that ignore my global theme_set()
